{
  "decision-lamp-survival-day-two": "WITH RECURSIVE failure_days AS (
  SELECT exit_day, COUNT(*) AS failures
  FROM lamp_exits
  WHERE outcome = 'failed' AND exit_day <= 2
  GROUP BY exit_day
), steps AS (
  SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY f.exit_day) AS step, f.failures,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lamp_exits AS l WHERE l.exit_day >= f.exit_day) AS at_risk
  FROM failure_days AS f
), km(step, survival) AS (
  SELECT 0, 1.0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.step, k.survival * (s.at_risk - s.failures) / s.at_risk
  FROM km AS k JOIN steps AS s ON s.step = k.step + 1
)
SELECT ROUND(survival, 6) AS survival_day_2
FROM km
ORDER BY step DESC
LIMIT 1",
  "decision-last-confirmed-shelf-before-inventory": "SELECT c.holding_code, n.shelf_code, n.slip_no
FROM inventory_close AS c
JOIN shelf_note AS n ON n.slip_no = (
  SELECT s.slip_no
  FROM shelf_note AS s
  WHERE s.holding_code = c.holding_code AND s.note_kind = 'sighted' AND s.note_day <= c.close_day
  ORDER BY s.note_day DESC, s.slip_no DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY c.holding_code",
  "decision-least-cost-dual-dealer-funding": "SELECT a.ticket_code AS a_code, b.ticket_code AS b_code,
       a.price_cents + b.price_cents AS cost_cents,
       a.hold_cents + b.hold_cents AS hold_cents
FROM funding_request AS r
JOIN dealer_ticket AS a ON a.desk_code = 'A' AND a.delivery_day <= r.cutoff_day
JOIN dealer_ticket AS b ON b.desk_code = 'B' AND b.delivery_day <= r.cutoff_day
WHERE a.buy_units + b.buy_units = r.need_units
  AND a.hold_cents + b.hold_cents <= r.cap_cents
ORDER BY cost_cents, a.ticket_code COLLATE BINARY, b.ticket_code COLLATE BINARY
LIMIT 1",
  "decision-least-cost-two-stage-finish": "SELECT s.source_id AS sand_source, w.source_id AS wax_source,
       s.sand_cents + w.wax_cents + s.handling_cents + CASE WHEN s.source_id = w.source_id THEN 0 ELSE w.handling_cents END AS total_cents,
       s.sand_hours + w.wax_hours AS total_hours
FROM finish_quote AS s CROSS JOIN finish_quote AS w
WHERE s.sand_cents IS NOT NULL AND w.wax_cents IS NOT NULL
  AND s.sand_hours + w.wax_hours <= 8
ORDER BY total_cents, total_hours, s.source_id COLLATE BINARY, w.source_id COLLATE BINARY
